title: UI/UX Designer

steps: Design degree (NID, NIFT, B.Des) or self-taught + portfolio
path.note: A portfolio matters more than a degree.

rows.label: Senior / product designer at strong companies

pros: Creative work with a direct impact on how people use products
Can enter without an engineering degree; remote-friendly
Grows into product design, research or design leadership
cons: Crowded entry market after the bootcamp boom; a portfolio is everything
Design by committee: stakeholders override your decisions
AI tools are speeding up routine UI work, so research and thinking skills matter more
sceneIdeas: The founder says "make the logo bigger" on your 5th iteration
User testing proves your favourite design wrong
An engineer says your design is "impossible"
Presenting to the CEO with 10 minutes' notice
